authority.rule: A cell changes from VALIDATION_NOT_RUN only with an immutable-candidate ordinary-entry receipt or an exact mature-backend rejection/missing record.

status_vocabulary.RUN_PASS: Every required region for this exact profile ran through the declared route and entry with retained receipts.
status_vocabulary.BACKEND_REJECTED: The named mature backend rejects the exact device/provider/version/format/shape domain.
status_vocabulary.UPSTREAM_MISSING: The pinned admitted mature sources do not implement the exact domain.
status_vocabulary.VALIDATION_NOT_RUN: The complete profile/route/entry fragment has no qualifying receipt yet.

capacity_policy.payload: Local Qwen uses verified checkpoint bytes; nonlocal profiles use format-valid nonzero payloads tied to fixed headers/configs.
